title: Compute effective material properties
action: Using the modified rule of mixture and the provided CNT efficiency parameters, compute the effective orthotropic elastic constants (E11, E22, G12) and Poisson's ratios for each reinforcement type (short, long) and each CNT volume fraction (0%, 5%, 10%, 15%). For 0% CNT, use pure matrix properties. Also compute the composite density from the rule of mixtures using the provided constituent densities. Store these properties for use in the subsequent GDQ analysis.
description: Intermediate calculation to obtain the orthotropic plate material constants (E11, E22, G12, nu12, nu21, rho) required for the free vibration analysis.

title: Compute fundamental frequencies via GDQ
action: Implement the generalized differential quadrature (GDQ) method to discretize the governing differential equations of free vibration for orthotropic square plates of thickness h = 0.005 m (side length L = 0.005 * (L/h) m) according to classical plate theory (CLPT), first-order shear deformation theory (FSDT) using shear correction factor κ = 5/6, and higher-order shear deformation theory (HSDT). For each combination of reinforcement type (short, long), plate theory, boundary condition (simply supported SSSS, clamped CCCC), aspect ratio (L/h = 10, 20, 40), and CNT volume fraction (0%, 5%, 10%, 15%), set up the algebraic eigenvalue problem and solve for the lowest natural frequency (fundamental frequency) in kHz. Output all results to frequencies.csv.
description: Scored artifact: the fundamental frequencies of the nanocomposite plates for all parameter combinations, as computed by the GDQ method.
output_schema: Columns: reinforcement_type (string, 'short' or 'long'), plate_theory (string, 'CLPT'/'FSDT'/'HSDT'), boundary (string, 'SSSS'/'CCCC'), aspect_ratio (int, 10, 20, or 40), CNT_volume_fraction (float, 0.0, 0.05, 0.10, or 0.15), frequency_kHz (float). One row per unique combination, no header duplication.
